note: Ratchet, not a cleanup mandate. knownOrphans records what was already unreachable under ratchetRoots when this gate landed; each needs a concrete reason, and an entry that becomes reachable is STALE and must be deleted. New orphans under ratchetRoots fail the build.

knownOrphans.src/render/graphicsLab.js: Developer technique gap-map served on its own route; intentionally not part of the game bundle graph.
knownOrphans.src/render/thruster/textures/encodePng.j: Build-time PNG encoder for thruster atlas generation; not a runtime path.
knownOrphans.src/render/thruster/textures/sample.js: Build-time CPU texture sampler for thruster/RCS atlases; not a runtime path.
knownOrphans.src/systems/signatureAdapters.js: Adapter layer for the unwired site signature model; blocked on the same wiring.
knownOrphans.src/systems/siteSignatureModel.js: Asteroid-site signature model. Same shape as siteThermalModel.js — kernel plus tests, no runtime consumer.
knownOrphans.src/systems/siteThermalModel.js: Asteroid-site thermal model. Pure kernel with tests and no runtime consumer; asteroidSites.js does not import it. Bind it to the site runtime or fold it into that system.
knownOrphans.src/ui/kit/lab.js: Renders the kit page (_kitlab.html, KIT_SPEC.md §10) — a dev harness served from the repo root, not a game screen; the kit itself (index.js) is on the route via src/ui/screens/mainMenu.js and uiRoot.js.
knownOrphans.src/render/backendDecision.js: PQ-044 (PERF-10 conditional WebGPU/TSL) is DEFERRED, so nothing on the default route selects a backend yet. Gated by scripts/check-backend-decision.mjs and scripts/check-render-path-parity.mjs; landed 2026-08-07.
knownOrphans.src/render/webgpuPresent.js: Present half of the same deferred PQ-044 slice; the WebGL present path is the only one wired. Gated by scripts/check-render-path-parity.mjs; landed 2026-08-21.
knownOrphans.src/render/batchedInstanceRenderer.js: Perf-rescue candidate held out of the default route until its own acceptance runs. Gated by scripts/check-batched-instance-renderer.mjs; landed 2026-08-07.
knownOrphans.src/render/presentPhaseTimers.js: Instrumentation staged for the hitch campaign, not yet on the player path. Gated by test/present-phase-timers.test.mjs; landed 2026-08-14.
knownOrphans.src/render/renderPackageDigestWorker.js: Worker loaded via new URL() from renderPackageDigest.js; the static import graph cannot see that wire.
knownOrphans.src/ui/commandDeckRefit.js: Off-route additive presentation lab; production does not import or auto-mount. Tests and commandDeckRefitHooks remain on the station path.
knownOrphans.src/ui/virtualList.js: PQ-184.01 list windowing kernel; long screens have not mounted it yet. Keep until that leaf wires market/contracts/ledger/codex or retires the component.
